headers.call_lift:
(r : Input)
    (rs : List Input) (acc : List StoredHostPreparation.Record)
    {k : ℕ} {s u : StoredComponentRecord.State}
    (ht : Trace (StoredComponentRecord.transition) k s u) :
    Trace (transition) k (.call r rs acc s) (.call r rs acc u)
headers.inputs_trace:
(rs : List Input)
    (acc : List StoredHostPreparation.Record) :
    Trace (transition) (scanSteps rs) (.inputs rs acc)
      (.reverse ((result rs).reverse++acc) [])
headers.reverse_trace:
(rs out : List StoredHostPreparation.Record) :
    Trace (transition) (rs.length+1) (.reverse rs out) (.halt (rs.reverse++out))
headers.bank_trace:
(rs : List Input) :
    Trace (transition) (scanSteps rs+rs.length+1) (.inputs rs []) (.halt (result rs))
headers.steps_le_input:
(rs : List Input) :
    scanSteps rs+rs.length+1 ≤ inputBound rs
